objective: Reduce two-lane physical routing pressure before any further paid build, without changing DP6 semantics.
diagnosis: The current two-lane topology is routing-congestion limited rather than merely compute-clock limited. Violations span the local FAE 200 MHz domain, shell clk_main_a0 250 MHz, and HBM 450 MHz domain.
rejected_actions: Do not create an AFI from the timing-failed Developer_CL.
Do not rerun the same topology with a longer watchdog.
Do not lower only the local compute clock again as the next experiment.
Do not alter frozen DP6 semantics to improve timing.
frontier: Inspect the generated AWS IPI CDMA topology and current fae_mem_merge -> axi_smc_cdma/S00_AXI funnel.
Design a split or more localized memory/interconnect topology that reduces cross-device routing pressure while preserving host-visible addresses and lane semantics.
Validate the new block design statically and record interface/address/clock-domain evidence.
Only if static validation is clean, estimate routability/resource impact and decide whether a paid physical build is justified.
If physically built, require final WNS>=0, TNS=0, WHS>=0, THS=0 before AFI promotion.

current_best_admissible_attacker.status: remains current attacker candidate until a faster parity-preserving physical configuration passes
